title: Tibs with Salsa
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian-style Tibs dish with a tangy salsa. This recipe is a unique combination of sour and beef flavors.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, heat the nourishing oil over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes or until translucent.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the habanero peppers and cook for another 2 minutes.
5. Add the beef strips and cook for 5-7 minutes or until browned.
6. Season with cumin, coriander, and oregano.
7. Meanwhile, combine the sour cream, diced tomatoes, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
8. Stir the salsa mixture and adjust the seasoning.
9. Serve the Tibs with the salsa on top.
10. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
11. Serve hot over injera or with steamed rice.
